source_lines.38: **Given:** A finite group $G$, a subgroup $H\le G$, and the trivial complex representation $\mathbf 1_H$ of $H$.
source_lines.40: [F1] The induced module consists of the functions $f:G\to\mathbb C$ satisfying $f(gh)=h^{-1}\cdot f(g)$, with $G$ acting by $(x\cdot f)(g)=f(x^{-1}g)$ ([[def-induced-r-linear-g-module-by-h-covariant-functions]]).
